description: SR2026 CBPR+ pacs.008 FIToFICstmrCdtTrf validation rules — production-ready with user-friendly error messages and fix suggestions.

bizSvc.message: Business Service identifier is wrong for pacs.008 in SR2026. Must be one of: swift.cbprplus.04 (non-STP) or swift.cbprplus.stp.04 (STP/MT103+).
bizSvc.fix: Set BizSvc to swift.cbprplus.04 for standard pacs.008, or swift.cbprplus.stp.04 for STP (MT103+) messages.
bizSvc.hint: Use swift.cbprplus.04 for regular credit transfers. Use swift.cbprplus.stp.04 only for STP (Straight-Through Processing) transfers originating from MT103+.

msgDefIdr.fix: Change Message Definition Identifier to pacs.008.001.08.

bizMsgIdr.message: Business Message ID contains invalid characters or is too long.
bizMsgIdr.fix: Use only allowed FIN-X characters and keep the value within 35 characters.

bizMsgIdrMissing.message: Business Message ID is missing from the header.
bizMsgIdrMissing.fix: Enter a Business Message ID in the AppHdr (maximum 35 characters).
bizMsgIdrMissing.hint: This must match the Group Header Message ID.

creDt.message: BAH Creation Date is missing or does not include a UTC timezone offset.
creDt.fix: Enter a valid Creation Date-Time with a UTC offset. Example: 2026-11-15T09:30:00+00:00
creDt.hint: Plain dates without a timezone (e.g. +00:00) are rejected.

from.fix: Enter the sending institution BIC in the AppHdr From field.

to.fix: Enter the receiving institution BIC in the AppHdr To field.

bizMsgIdrEqualsMsgId.message: Business Message ID and Group Header Message ID do not match.
bizMsgIdrEqualsMsgId.fix: Ensure Business Message ID and Group Header Message ID are identical.
bizMsgIdrEqualsMsgId.hint: Set both fields to the same unique reference value.

fromBicMatchesInstgAgt.message: BAH From BIC does not match the Instructing Agent BIC.
fromBicMatchesInstgAgt.fix: Use the same BIC for the BAH From field and the Instructing Agent.
fromBicMatchesInstgAgt.hint: 8-character BICs are automatically padded to 11 by appending XXX.

toBicMatchesInstdAgt.message: BAH To BIC does not match the Instructed Agent BIC.
toBicMatchesInstdAgt.fix: Use the same BIC for the BAH To field and the Instructed Agent.

nbOfTxsMatchesCount.message: Number of Transactions does not match the actual count of transactions in the message.
nbOfTxsMatchesCount.fix: Set Number of Transactions to match the exact number of transaction blocks in the message.

MsgId.message: Group Header Message ID is missing.
MsgId.fix: Enter a Message ID in the Group Header (maximum 35 characters).
MsgId.hint: This value must also match the Business Message ID in the header.

CreDtTm.message: Group Header Creation Date-Time is missing.
CreDtTm.fix: Enter a valid Creation Date-Time with a UTC offset. Example: 2026-11-15T09:30:00+00:00

NbOfTxs.fix: Enter the total number of transaction blocks included in this message.
NbOfTxs.hint: This value must match the actual count of transaction blocks.

SttlmInf.fix: Add a Settlement Information block containing a Settlement Method.

SttlmMtd.message: Settlement Method is missing or contains an invalid value.
SttlmMtd.fix: Set Settlement Method to one of: INDA, INGA, COVE, or CLRG.

transactionBlock.description: Mandatory fields in each CdtTrfTxInf transaction block

PmtId.fix: Add a Payment Identification block containing End-to-End ID and UETR.

PmtId.EndToEndId.message: End-to-End ID is missing or blank.
PmtId.EndToEndId.fix: Enter an End-to-End ID. Use NOTPROVIDED if the originator did not supply one.
PmtId.EndToEndId.hint: This field cannot be empty. Maximum 35 characters.

PmtId.UETR.message: UETR is missing or is not a valid lowercase UUID v4.
PmtId.UETR.fix: Enter a valid lowercase UUID v4 value. Example: 4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267
PmtId.UETR.hint: Format: 8-4-4-4-12 lowercase hex digits. Third group starts with 4. Fourth starts with 8, 9, a, or b.

IntrBkSttlmAmt.fix: Enter a valid Interbank Settlement Amount greater than zero with a currency code. Example: 10000.00 USD

IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy.message: Settlement Amount currency code is missing.
IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy.fix: Add a valid ISO 4217 currency code to the Settlement Amount. Example: USD, EUR, GBP

InstdAmt.message: Instructed Amount is missing. This field became mandatory in SR2026.
InstdAmt.fix: Enter the original Instructed Amount with a currency code.
InstdAmt.hint: This was optional in SR2025 but is now mandatory in SR2026.

InstdAmt.Ccy.message: Instructed Amount currency code is missing.
InstdAmt.Ccy.fix: Add a valid ISO 4217 currency code to the Instructed Amount.

IntrBkSttlmDt.fix: Enter a valid Settlement Date in YYYY-MM-DD format without any timezone. Example: 2026-11-15

ChrgBr.fix: Select a Charge Bearer value: SLEV, SHAR, CRED, or DEBT.
ChrgBr.hint: SLEV means charges follow the service level agreement.

InstgAgt.BICFI.fix: Enter the Instructing Agent BIC. This must match the BAH From BIC.

InstdAgt.BICFI.fix: Enter the Instructed Agent BIC. This must match the BAH To BIC.

Dbtr.fix: Provide the Debtor details including name and address.

Dbtr.Nm.hint: Required by FATF Recommendation 16 for wire transfers.

DbtrAcct.fix: Enter the Debtor account number (IBAN preferred).

DbtrAcct.Id.fix: Enter a valid Debtor account identifier — use IBAN where possible.
DbtrAcct.Id.hint: IBAN format: 2-letter country code + 2 check digits + up to 30 alphanumeric characters.

DbtrAgt.message: Debtor Agent (ordering customer's bank) is missing.
DbtrAgt.fix: Enter the Debtor Agent details (BIC preferred).

DbtrAgt.BICFI.message: Debtor Agent BIC is not provided.
DbtrAgt.BICFI.fix: Enter the Debtor Agent BIC where available. Name and Address may be used if BIC is unavailable.
DbtrAgt.BICFI.hint: If BIC is present, Name and Postal Address must not be included alongside it.

CdtrAgt.fix: Enter the Creditor Agent details (BIC preferred).

CdtrAgt.BICFI.message: Creditor Agent BIC is not provided.
CdtrAgt.BICFI.fix: Enter the Creditor Agent BIC where available. Name and Address may be used if BIC is unavailable.
CdtrAgt.BICFI.hint: If BIC is present, Name and Postal Address must not be included alongside it.

Cdtr.fix: Provide the Creditor details including name and address.

Cdtr.Nm.hint: Required by FATF Recommendation 16 for wire transfers.

CdtrAcct.fix: Enter the Creditor account number (IBAN preferred).

CdtrAcct.Id.fix: Enter a valid Creditor account identifier — use IBAN where possible.
CdtrAcct.Id.hint: IBAN format: 2-letter country code + 2 check digits + up to 30 alphanumeric characters.

addressRules.description: SR2026 removes unstructured-only addresses (AdrLine without TwnNm/Ctry). The default and required combination is Hybrid: TwnNm + Ctry + up to two AdrLine elements. TwnNm and Ctry are mandatory in all postal addresses.

adrLineDeprecated.errorMessage: Unstructured address lines (AdrLine without TwnNm/Ctry) are no longer accepted in SR2026. Use Hybrid: AdrLine alongside mandatory TwnNm and Ctry.
adrLineDeprecated.fix: Add mandatory <TwnNm> and <Ctry> alongside the existing <AdrLine> elements to form a Hybrid address.

townName.errorMessage: Debtor Postal Address is missing the Town/City.
townName.fix: Enter the Town or City in the Debtor postal address.

country.errorMessage: Debtor Postal Address is missing the Country.
country.fix: Enter a valid 2-letter country code in the Debtor postal address.

townName.errorMessage: Creditor Postal Address is missing the Town/City.
townName.fix: Enter the Town or City in the Creditor postal address.

country.errorMessage: Creditor Postal Address is missing the Country.
country.fix: Enter a valid 2-letter country code in the Creditor postal address.

proxyRules.description: When a Proxy element is present, the Proxy Type (Tp) sub-element becomes mandatory in SR2026.
proxyRules.errorMessage: Proxy Type <Tp> is mandatory inside <Prxy> when Proxy is present in SR2026.

uetr.message: UETR is not a valid UUID v4 or contains uppercase letters.
uetr.fix: Enter a valid lowercase UUID v4 value. Example: 4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267
uetr.hint: Third group starts with 4. Fourth group starts with 8, 9, a, or b. Lowercase only.

settlementDate.message: Settlement Date contains a timezone offset or is in the wrong format.
settlementDate.fix: Enter the date in YYYY-MM-DD format without any timezone. Example: 2026-11-15

serviceLevelRules.description: GPI Service Level restrictions in SR2026.
serviceLevelRules.errorMessage: GPI Service Level code is not allowed in SR2026. Only G001 is permitted.
serviceLevelRules.fix: Use G001 only. GPI codes G002 through G009 are no longer permitted in SR2026.

dateRules.description: Date fields in SR2026 must use CBPR_Date format (YYYY-MM-DD only). Timezone offsets are not allowed.
dateRules.errorMessage: Date field contains timezone offset which is not allowed in SR2026. Use YYYY-MM-DD format without timezone.
dateRules.fix: Remove timezone offset from date fields (e.g. change '2026-11-20Z' to '2026-11-20').

structuredLength.message: Structured Remittance content exceeds the maximum allowed length.
structuredLength.fix: Reduce the content in the Structured Remittance block to within 9000 characters.

rules.errorMessage: Structured Remittance block exceeds maximum 9000 business characters.
rules.fix: Reduce the content inside <Strd> to within 9000 characters.
